name: Université Paris-Saclay International Master's Scholarship (IDEX)
duration: 1 year (M2) or 2 years (M1, auto-renewed into M2 on completing all required credits)
eligibleNationalities: Open to students of any foreign (non-French) nationality; no country list. Bangladeshi nationals are eligible. Must be enrolling in France for the first time and be under 30 during the year of application.
ageLimit: Under 30 years of age during the year of application
applicationFee: No separate scholarship application fee (selected students are emailed a link to the online form); standard master's admission may carry its own platform/admission costs.
benefits: Living grant of EUR 10,000 per year, paid in 10 monthly instalments (September to June) by bank transfer
One-off travel and visa flat fee of up to EUR 900 (amount depends on the candidate's country of origin)
Automatic renewal for a second year for M1 laureates who pass all required credits and are admitted to an eligible M2
Support with administrative procedures (visa, residence permit) and the accommodation search, plus access to international-student services and PhD-pathway information sessions
fundingCovers: Travel and visa flat fee (up to EUR 900)
monthlyStipend: EUR 10,000/year paid in 10 monthly instalments (Sept-June), i.e. approx. EUR 1,000/month during the funded period
renewalConditions: M1 laureates: scholarship renews for a second (M2) year only on obtaining all required credits and being admitted to an M2 at Université Paris-Saclay; if a laureate must repeat the year, the scholarship is stopped. No change of program or deferment allowed; the scholarship can be suspended for repeated unjustified absence.
postStudyWork: Not specified by the program (program is explicitly oriented toward students wishing to pursue a PhD at Université Paris-Saclay)

timeline.opens: Applies via the master's admission cycle (M1/M2 application platforms); scholarship candidate selection by program coordinators precedes the deadlines below
timeline.deadline: 31 March 2026, 11:59pm (Paris time) — to apply for the scholarship after being selected; candidate selection by master's program coordinators deadline is 25 March 2026
timeline.notes: Dates are the official 'Important dates - 2026' for the 2026-2027 academic year as published on the program page (crawled 2026-06-18; anchor date 2026-06). The scholarship deadline (31 March 2026) has already passed as of the 2026-06 anchor; these are the current published cycle's dates. Step 1 is to apply for and be admitted to an eligible Paris-Saclay master's before the scholarship deadline; only admitted students selected by course coordinators receive the scholarship application form.

requiredDocuments: Admission to an eligible Université Paris-Saclay master's (M1 via INCEPTION/MonMaster, M2 via INCEPTION) — completed before the scholarship deadline
Online scholarship application form (link emailed automatically to candidates selected by course coordinators)
Name and contact details of two references (course coordinator, professor, internship supervisor, etc.) who complete a recommendation online before the deadline (if applicable)

Statement of purpose / motivation for the master's (and, for M2 candidates, motivation for pursuing a PhD at Université Paris-Saclay) — refugee/subsidiary-protection status should be indicated here if applicable
mustKnow: Tuition is NOT covered. The regulations state registration and tuition fees are the laureate's own responsibility; a partial/full discount can only be requested from the enrolment institution at its sole discretion. This is a living-stipend (EUR 10,000/yr) + travel award, not a fully-funded tuition+stipend package.

Two-step process: you must first apply for and be ADMITTED to an eligible Paris-Saclay master's before the scholarship deadline; only admitted students selected by course coordinators are invited to apply for the scholarship (you cannot apply directly to the scholarship).

Hard eligibility gates: foreign nationality, first-time enrolment in France (never previously registered at a French higher-education institution, except exchanges/EMJMD without a French degree/internships/language programs), and under 30 during the year of application.
Cannot be combined with any other funding above EUR 600/month, nor with France Excellence Eiffel, France Excellence Europa, or Erasmus Mundus scholarships.

Stipend is reduced/suspended for months spent abroad, non-compulsory mobility, gap years (allowed but unfunded), and certain internships (e.g. French internships >EUR 1,000/month stipend, or paid/unpaid internships abroad).
No advance payment: the stipend and travel fee are paid only after arrival in France and registration in the admitted program; no deferment is allowed.
Vocational/apprenticeship master's programs (« formations en apprentissage ») are not eligible.
languageRequirements: Not set by the scholarship itself; depends on the chosen master's program (English-taught and French-taught tracks both exist at Université Paris-Saclay). Verify the specific program's language requirement.
standardizedTests: Not required by the scholarship (no GRE/GMAT requirement stated)
